product: The Ordinary Caffeine Solution 5% + EGCG Depuffing and Brightening Eye Serum 30ml
text: This caffeine eye serum has a watery gel texture. A small amount goes a long way and absorbs without residue. It does not have a hydrating effect. But I was after the calming and brightening effect. After a while of continuous use, I did not notice a difference with under eye colour. Maybe my under eye colour is cause by something other than pigment, thus it’s beyond the scope of what this serum can provide. Not only that, within around 1-2 weeks of continuous use, my skin started becoming dry wherever I apply this serum. I did takes it beyond under eye skin. I went back to check and realise this serum contain lactic acid. As someone with sensitive skin this proofs to be too much. Maybe using this on alternating days might resolve the drying issue. But overall this did not work the way I had hoped. I’m still giving credits to the antioxidants profile and the easy to spread texture.
